verdict.rationale: Better Stack's status page product documents SSO, password, and IP protection for private status pages aimed at internal teams or enterprise customers. The getting-started docs confirm password protection restricts access to chosen people. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on SSO and IP-allowlist configuration for status pages, per-audience (customer-specific) page segmentation details, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I can run private or internal status pages with access control for customer-specific or employee-only audiences

citations.quote: SSO, password, and IP protection. Create a private status page for internal teams or enterprise customers.
To create a private status page, use the password protection to only allow chosen people to access it.
